summaries.title: OpenELM: An Efficient Language Model Family with Open-source Training and Inference Framework
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于系统与工程框架。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **OpenELM** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：To this end, we release OpenELM, a state-of-the-art open language model。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：OpenELM uses a layer-wise scaling strategy to efficiently allocate parameters within each layer of the transformer model, leading to enhanced accuracy。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **2.36%, 2×**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（To this end, we release OpenELM, a state-of-the-art open language model；For example, with a parameter budget of approximately one billion parameters, OpenELM exhibits a 2.36% improvement...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为社区高关注度代表作（HF 126 赞），本工作证明了系统级编排/底层执行优化在 **训练与强化学习** 落地中的决定性收益；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Multi-Head Mixture-of-Experts

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用稀疏专家路由与解耦表征设计。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We propose Multi-Head Mixture-of-Experts (MH-MoE), which employs a multi-head mechanism to split each token into multiple sub-tokens。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Extensive experimental results across three tasks: English-focused language modeling, Multi-lingual language modeling and Masked multi-modality modeling tasks, demonstrate the...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 60 赞），本工作为突破 **混合专家与动态深度 (MoE/MoD)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We also explore qualitative characteristics of Pegasus-1 , demonstrating its capabilities as well as its limitations, in order to provide readers a balanced view of its current state...）。

summaries.title: FlashSpeech: Efficient Zero-Shot Speech Synthesis
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销、安全对齐脆弱性、隐私版权与潜在失控风险」痛点，作者围绕 **FlashSpeech** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖扩散模型（Diffusion Model）、零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we present FlashSpeech, a large-scale zero-shot speech synthesis system with approximately 5% of the inference time compared with previous work。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制、高质量合成数据构造与精选配比、迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Efficient speech synthesis using a lower computing budget to achieve quality on par with previous work remains a significant challenge。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **5%, 20× faster**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（In this paper, we present FlashSpeech, a large-scale zero-shot speech synthesis system with approximately 5% of the inference time compared with previous work）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 32 赞），本工作为突破 **多模态与统一基座** 中的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Align Your Steps: Optimizing Sampling Schedules in Diffusion Models

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比、迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Sampling from DMs can be seen as solving a differential equation through a discretized set of noise levels known as the sampling schedule。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Diffusion models (DMs) have established themselves as the state-of-the-art generative modeling approach in the...；We evaluate our novel approach on several image, video as well as 2D toy data synthesis benchmarks, using a...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 23 赞），本工作为突破 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Transformers Can Represent n-gram Language Models
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**模型架构与序列建模**（Architecture）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Transformers Can Represent n-gram Language** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖模型架构与序列建模（Architecture）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we focus on the relationship between transformer LMs and n-gram LMs, a simple and historically relevant class of language models。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We contend that this is an ill-suited problem in the study of language models (LMs), which are definitionally probability distributions over strings。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We show that transformer LMs using the hard or sparse attention mechanisms can exactly represent any n-gram LM, giving us a concrete lower bound on their probabilistic representational...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 21 赞），本工作修正了对 **模型架构与序列建模** 的经验性直觉假设，为后续算法改进指明了真正起作用的因果关键点；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
